title: Global Xero & QuickBooks Accounting Firm Leads
description: Find public accounting firm and advisor profiles worldwide from Xero and QuickBooks directories. Build 0.1.8 validated UK, US, Australia, and Singapore directory routes in the global cloud gate; website enrichment is best-effort, bounded, and disabled by default.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Cities, regions, postcodes, or countries to search. UK, US, Australia, and Singapore routes are validated first; other locations are best-effort.

maxResults.title: Maximum leads
maxResults.description: Maximum number of final deduplicated leads across all locations and sources.

extractContacts.title: Extract public contact people
extractContacts.description: Retain publicly listed accounting-firm contacts. Enabled by default; set false to omit contact records from final output.

enrichWebsites.title: Enrich company websites
enrichWebsites.description: Opt-in bounded website enrichment. Each canonical public domain gets at most three HTML pages, a 10-second page deadline, a 30-second domain budget, two retries, abortable requests, and low concurrency; failures preserve the directory record. Default is false.

includeRawData.title: Include raw source data
includeRawData.description: Include compact source fields for debugging.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for public directory requests.
